Sam Rivera: morning team :wave: I'm oncall this week but hitting a couple blockers — can't clone the runbook repo (403) and my PagerDuty test didn't route to me. Anyone around to help quick?
Alex Chen: welcome! For runbooks you'll need Confluence/read perms and repo access. PagerDuty usually fails if the invite isn't accepted or your Okta groups aren't in sync (oncall-rotation). Which email did you use?
Sam Rivera: sam.rivera@redwood.com
Jasmin Patel: resending PD invite now. :mailbox_with_mail:
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty invite resent to sam.rivera@redwood.com — follow the link to join the rotation. :white_check_mark:
Sam Rivera: still seeing git error: "fatal: unable to access 'https://git.redwood.com/runbooks/': the requested URL returned error: 403"
Kyle Morgan: probably team membership. Can you run `curl -I https://git.redwood.com/runbooks` and paste the headers? I'll add you to git-runbooks if needed.
Sam Rivera: header shows WWW-Authenticate: Okta, X-Served-By: git-router
Kyle Morgan: added you to the git-runbooks team and granted read. Try cloning then trigger the PD test with: ```bash
redwoodctl alert trigger --service=runbook-staging --type=test
```
Sam Rivera: cloning works now and I just received the PagerDuty notification — test verified. Also saw the shadowing session in my calendar, when is that?
Jasmin Patel: Thursday 10:00am PT, pairing with a senior for the first wave. Zoom link in the invite.
Alex Chen: short triage cheat-sheet: 1) Acknowledge in PagerDuty, 2) run `runbook lookup <service>` for the runbook, 3) post a concise update to #incidents (what you saw, what you're doing), 4) escalate after 15 minutes without progress. We'll be updating runbooks this week with exact commands.
Sam Rivera: perfect, thanks for the quick fixes and tips :pray:
Oncall Bot: Reminder: complete the "Oncall Basics" lab in Learning Portal by Friday to unlock full rotation privileges.
